meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw 的首次安装与配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接触 NanoClaw 需要初始化设置
copy.tagline_en: Complete initial setup and configuration of NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are new to NanoClaw and need to initialize it

howto.what: 当用户请求安装或配置 NanoClaw 时，Claude 会指导用户在终端运行 `bash nanoclaw.sh`，该脚本会自动完成依赖、容器镜像、凭据、服务等设置；若中途出错，脚本会用 Claude 辅助恢复并从中断处继续。
howto.when: 当用户想安装、配置 NanoClaw 或进行首次设置，或说出“setup”“install”“configure nanoclaw”这些词时。

say.note: Claude 会告诉你运行 bash nanoclaw.sh
会触发 setup 技能，引导你完成配置
Claude 将指示你执行安装脚本

howto.what_en: When the user requests NanoClaw setup, Claude tells them to run `bash nanoclaw.sh`. That script performs the installation and configuration, and offers Claude-assisted recovery if an error occurs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to install, configure, or run first-time setup for NanoClaw, or says "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw".

say_en.note: Claude tells you to run bash nanoclaw.sh
Claude will instruct you to run the script
